name: deepcgm-generic-e32-r2-seed6
description: DeepCGM-generic (Hyper-LoRA) pretrained on 45 wheat cultivars and finetuned on 17 held-out cultivars.
selection: configuration chosen by lowest mean finetuning loss over d_emb in {8,16,32} x r in {2,4,8}, 10 seeds each; released weights are the best of the 10 seeds of the winning configuration
note: one member of the 10-seed ensemble reported in the paper

reference_loss_counts.description: valid-observation counts of the 224 plot-season finetuning batch used for the released weights (Table 3 of the paper, Finetuning column). Pass --reproduce-reference-batch to finetune.py to reuse them, which lets a single-cultivar run follow the same trajectory as the original multi-cultivar fine-tune.
